summary: Iter284 — Frontend-only verification of the sticky-footer layout fix in the Integrator Templates edit dialog (EntityTemplatesConfig / context=INTEGRADORES). Tested at 1366x768 and 1280x720 with both an existing large-content template and after injecting ~12,398 chars of HTML into the editor. PASS on all acceptance criteria: (1) 'Guardar' visible in viewport immediately upon opening — no page zoom-out needed; (2) body has internal overflow-y (scrollHeight > clientHeight) and scrolls independently; (3) footer stays fixed at same y-coordinate during body scroll; (4) window.scrollY remains 0 (dialog does not push page); (5) Guardar clickable — created a TEST_ template, dialog closed and 'Plantilla creada' toast shown, then cleaned up. Regression: entity-upload-doc-dialog opens and closes normally.
action_items: (no-op) Layout fix verified end-to-end at 1366x768 and 1280x720. Ready to close ticket.
critical_code_review_comments: EntityTemplatesConfig.jsx L179-207: Correct flex-column layout — DialogContent 'max-w-3xl max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col p-0 overflow-hidden'; DialogHeader/DialogFooter with shrink-0; body div 'flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto px-6 py-4'. The min-h-0 on the flex child is the key detail that enables internal scrolling — implemented correctly.
Footer uses border-t + bg-white + shrink-0, which visually separates it from scrolling content and keeps it anchored — no absolute/sticky positioning needed (natural flex behavior). Clean solution.
Pre-existing (non-regression, already noted in iter283): hydration warning from visual-editor wrapper (<span> inside <tbody>, <tr> inside <span>) on /integrators. Not introduced by this fix.
Menor observation: DialogFooter here uses shadcn's default flex layout (buttons right-aligned) which is consistent with other dialogs — good UX consistency.
